meta.title: Pricing — ONIR CMS
meta.description: Start for free with self-hosting, choose a Cloud plan published from the backoffice, or get support from our team.
meta.ogDescription: Start for free with self-hosting, choose a Cloud plan published from the backoffice, or get support from our team.

hero.title: Choose your plan.
hero.lead: Start for free with self-hosting, choose a Cloud plan published from the backoffice, or get support from our team.

title: Clear plans, from open source to tailored support.
lead: There are a thousand and one ways to support our mission: by participating, or by using our service.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted and self-configured
selfHosted.lead: Install ONIR CMS on your infrastructure, keep control of your data, and configure your instance yourself.

cloud.title: Cloud plans
cloud.lead: Scalable cloud plans for your needs, designed for small and medium businesses.
cloud.empty: Cloud plans will be available soon.
cloud.detail: Several plans and durations are available below.
cloud.offersLead: Choose the plan and duration that fit your organization.

enterprise.title: Premium support and ONIR-CMS configuration
enterprise.lead: Our team handles installation, configuration, and support for your instance.

appointment.title: Let’s talk about your project
appointment.lead: Answer a few questions and we will get back to you with a tailored proposal.
appointment.budget: What budget do you have in mind?
appointment.note: Your request will be prepared in WhatsApp or your email client. No data is stored on this site.

ctaLead: Let’s discuss your project and find the right fit.

subscription.title: Cloud subscription request
subscription.lead: Enter your organization and contact details. You will receive a unique code to include in the Orange Money or Mvola transfer.
subscription.successLead: Make the Mobile Money payment with this code in the description. An operator will verify your payment.

support.title: Support AI within everyone’s reach.
support.lead: By using our service, you help fund open, accessible AI for organizations here and elsewhere.

partner.title: Become a partner
partner.lead: Join the ONIR CMS ecosystem and build useful assistants with us.

offerDescriptions.STARTER: Start with a first chatbot and 1 million tokens per month.
offerDescriptions.BUSINESS: For SMEs using several chatbots and a professional volume.
offerDescriptions.SCALE: For high-volume organizations with multiple use cases.

market.label: Market
market.cloudTitle: ONIR CMS Cloud is currently available in Madagascar only
market.cloudLead: Because we do not yet have a reliable international online payment partner, Cloud plans are currently limited to Madagascar. We are working on solutions for international organizations. Self-hosted, Enterprise and Partner offers remain available.
